SUGANYA R Data Analyst | Capital Markets Reconciliation | Advanced Excel | SQL | Power BI

Bangalore, Karnataka, India | 9176667080 | suganyaraghupathy8@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Data Analyst with experience across settlements, investment banking reconciliation, securities reconciliation, fixed asset management, reporting and data validation. Strong hands-on capability in Advanced Excel, Excel Macros, VBA, MySQL, Power BI, Tableau, DAX and TLM. Experienced in analysing large datasets, decoding SQL logic, performing reconciliation and validation, preparing TDS/FDD/UAT documentation, and automating repetitive data-processing and reporting activities. Comfortable collaborating with business, operations, IT and client stakeholders.

TECHNICAL SKILLS



• • • •

Advanced Excel: Pivot Tables, Pivot Charts, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, IF/IFS, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, conditional formatting, tables, charts and data validation. Excel Automation: Excel Macros and VBA for data formatting, report preparation, data consolidation and repetitive workflow automation. Data Analysis: Data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation, validation, exception analysis, large-dataset handling and business reporting. Analytics & BI: Power BI, Tableau, DAX, dashboard development, KPI reporting and data visualisation. Database & Applications: MySQL, SQL query analysis, TLM, Cognos, Power Query and basic Python. Documentation & Testing: TDS, FDD, UAT documentation, query validation, migration documentation and process improvement.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

HCL Technologies – Senior Analyst | Bangalore | May 2025 – Aug 2026 Client / Team: Just Energy – Settlements Team • Managed settlement-related activities, ensuring accurate and timely processing within defined SLAs. • • • •

Analysed and decoded pre-existing SQL queries to understand business logic, source tables, joins, filters, calculations and dependencies. Reverse-engineered legacy query logic by tracing source tables and validating calculations against production data. Prepared TDS, FDD and UAT documentation based on decoded query logic and business requirements. Performed UAT by validating query results against live data, checking calculation logic, identifying discrepancies and confirming output accuracy.

Used Advanced Excel, including Pivot Tables, lookup formulas, conditional logic, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, charts and data validation, for data

analysis, reconciliation and business reporting.

Used Excel Macros and VBA to automate repetitive data-processing and reporting activities, including data formatting, report preparation,

data consolidation and recurring workflows.

Worked with large datasets to perform data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation and validation before settlement and invoice

•

processing. Created and maintained Excel dashboards and automated reports using formulas, tables, charts and validation controls. Performed invoice processing, sanity checks and data-quality validation; handled Month-End Close activities and investigated exceptions with stakeholders.

JP Morgan Chase – Consultant | Bangalore | Sep 2021 – Jun 2022 • • • • •

Performed agent reconciliation and Central Securities Depository (CSD) reconciliation using TLM and Excel. Created raw files by analysing and segregating Cognos reports using Advanced Excel functions. Coordinated with clients to clear outstanding reconciliation breaks and updated source codes for new accounts. Designed interactive Power BI dashboards using data models and visualisations to present actionable insights. Applied Excel-based validation and reconciliation checks to improve reporting accuracy.

SmartStream Technologies – Analyst | Bangalore | Nov 2018 – Jun 2019 • • • • • Used Excel-based analysis and validation to investigate reconciliation exceptions.

Delivered reconciliations for equities and derivatives across APAC and EMEA markets within SLA. Administered TLM applications, including static-data updates and onboarding of new reconciliations. Conducted UAT testing in MySQL and supported enhancements to improve system efficiency. Prepared documentation for pre- and post-migration activities.

DBOI Global Services – Analyst | Bangalore | Oct 2014 – Sep 2016 • Managed reconciliations for global markets using TLM 2.7 applications. •

Coordinated with IT and middle-office teams to address critical reconciliation issues.

• •

Automated data workflows and built Tableau dashboards for operational reporting. Performed data validation and reporting activities using Excel and reconciliation outputs.

Flextronics Technologies – Analyst | Chennai | Jul 2012 – Sep 2013 • Maintained and reconciled fixed-asset transactions for 14 sites under US GAAP standards. • • • • Optimised data models and used Power Query for data transformation, reducing data-analysis time by 40%. •

Prepared monthly depreciation schedules and balance-sheet reports and verified supporting documentation. Conducted on-site asset audits and contributed to process improvements. Created Power BI dashboards with dynamic visualisations, bar charts, heatmaps and KPIs.

Completed a document-retention project ahead of schedule and received recognition for efficiency.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATION

M.B.A. (Finance) – University of Madras, Chennai | 2015–2017 • • LANGUAGES

B.Com. (General) – Meenakshi College for Women, Chennai | 2009–2012

Data Analyst Certification – ExcelR
